title: Inductive-limit bounded Lipschitz cylinder form contract
question: Do finite-support bounded C1 cylinder multipliers define a volume-compatible inductive-limit test algebra with the same two-orientation Q3 form bounds, while leaving dynamics convergence as a separate gate?

model.cylinder: A_f is a bounded finite-support C1 multiplication cylinder with ||f||_infinity <= M and ||grad f||_infinity <= L
model.ambient_embedding: A fixed support S is extended from a finite graph Lambda to any larger bounded-degree graph Lambda' by the same multiplier on S and the identity outside S
model.form_bound: q_K[A_f psi] <= (2 M^2) q_K[psi] + (L^2/chi)||psi||^2 for either shifted Q3 Friedrichs form
model.cross_orientation: The opposite form orientation pays the exact K_edge <= 21 K_on multiplier from EXP-001131
model.product_algebra: For f,g, M_fg <= M_f M_g and L_fg <= M_f L_g + M_g L_f, so products remain in the same bounded C1 cylinder class
model.qft_role: This is a compatible bounded test algebra contract for the inductive-limit QFT route; it does not construct alpha_t or identify an OS/KMS/GNS limit

adversarial_review.check: Only the finite support is changed under an ambient-volume embedding; the multiplier is identity outside that support and no volume-dependent derivative term is added.
Same-form and cross-form square-root products remain separate, and the cross factor 21 is inherited rather than silently replaced by one.
The product gradient bound uses M_f L_g + M_g L_f; no unbounded polynomial is admitted by the bounded-cylinder contract.
Constants are uniform in ambient volume only at fixed support; support growth and arbitrary local observables remain open.
Compatibility of test multipliers is not identified with convergence of finite-volume dynamics or state limits.
Direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
R320 formalizes only the rational product, degree-six, and embedding constants; no operator or thermodynamic theorem is encoded.

lean_crosscheck.role: R320 checks exact rational product and volume-embedding bookkeeping only; it does not formalize multiplication operators, Friedrichs representation, dynamics, or limits.

qft_interface.closed: A fixed-support bounded C1 cylinder test algebra contract compatible with ambient bounded-degree graph embeddings and explicit same/cross form bounds independent of ambient volume.
qft_interface.open: Unbounded polynomial products, exact CCR domains, cutoff/beta modular transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, finite-volume dynamics convergence, exhaustion-independent states, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This is a bounded algebra/form interface only; it supplies no heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing inductive-limit test-algebra contract. It establishes compatibility of a bounded fixed-support cylinder class, not a thermodynamic QFT dynamics or any downstream physical theorem.
no_overclaim: The package closes only the declared fixed-support bounded C1 cylinder compatibility and form constants. It is not a common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result.
